maddeler.e:
استرجعوا (form X)
# اِسْتَرْجَعُوا (istarjaʕū) /is.tar.d͡ʒa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَرْجَعَ (istarjaʕa)
# اُسْتُرْجِعُوا (usturjiʕū) /us.tur.d͡ʒi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْجَعَ (istarjaʕa)
# اِسْتَرْجِعُوا (istarjiʕū) /is.tar.d͡ʒi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْجَعَ (istarjaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
